sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has drawn attention of this Court towards the order dated 31.5.2017 passed in Case U/S 482/378/407 No.3795 of 2017, Indra Kumar vs. State of U.P. and another, which was dismissed with liberty to the applicant to move regular bail application and learned trial court was directed to consider the same expeditiously.

entities.text: Indra Kumar vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Since 2017 the applicant is absconding.
He has not even complied with the order dated 31.5.2017.
The case is of dowry death and looking to the gravity of the offence no case for anticipatory bail is made out.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was suffering from cervical and therefore, he could not appear before the trial court.
Perused the record.
The explanation given by the applicant in not complying the order dated 31.5.2017 is not satisfactory.
Since 2017 seven years have passed.
The applicant appears to be absconding from the trial court coupled with the fact that he has not availed the remedy of regular bail as provided by coordinate Bench of this Court.
He has not cooperated in the trial.
No case for anticipatory bail is made out.
Accordingly the application for anticipatory bail is rejected.
